en: Black-and-white postcard featuring a high-contrast graphic print of an abstract architectural installation or model viewed from above. The composition shows angular building-like forms, stair elements, and walls arranged within a circular or cylindrical boundary. At the very top, typed text reads "Kennedy & Violich Architecture Installation Design & Model." There is no handwriting, stamp, or other visible postal markings on the front.
